data.define: Used when you have almost no money at all.

misuse.text: Don't say 'flat broke' about a broken phone.

data.l1_hook: Flat broke: posso pegar dez dólares emprestado?

native.tip: “flat broke” = na pindaíba. Exemplo: “I'm flat broke until Friday.”
native.caption:
O que significa “flat broke”?
“flat broke” = na pindaíba.
Exemplo: “I'm flat broke until Friday.” (Estou flat broke até sexta-feira.)
